trechos: Intel (INTC) ended the recent trading session at $101.40, demonstrating a -3.15% change from the preceding day's closing price.
This move lagged the S&P 500's daily loss of 0.06%.
Meanwhile, the Dow experienced a rise of 0.38%, and the technology-dominated Nasdaq saw a decrease of 0.44%.

The company is scheduled to release its earnings on October 29, 2026.
The company is expected to report EPS of $0.38, up 65.22% from the prior-year quarter.

trechos: O Dow Jones Brazil Titans 20 ADR registrou leve variação positiva de 0,03%, a 27.576,21 pontos.

itens.titulo: Fed’s Hammack says Treasury yields modest by historic standards
itens.descricao: Fed’s Hammack says Treasury yields modest by historic standards Yahoo Finance UK
trechos: Investing.com -- Cleveland Federal Reserve President Beth Hammack said on Monday that current US Treasury yields align with historical norms, adding that a return to 3% home mortgage rates would likely signal economic problems.
Hammack said the rates on the 10-year Treasury note now match levels seen in the 1990s.
"These rates look like higher rates but I think of these as modest," she stated.
She noted that low mortgage rates from the 2007-2009 financial crisis through the COVID-19 pandemic coincided with sluggish growth and aggressive central bank intervention.
Current mortgage rates stand above 7%.
She indicated the central bank is hearing "early warning signs" of a possible problem with inflation expectations.
Hammack said there is a need to "cool the economy at the margins" and that more policy restraint is needed.
